name: agent-compact-advisor
description: Status line score 0-100 for how good a moment it is to /compact now, with reasons; offers a ready /compact that keeps goal, decisions, leftovers and paths, and adds that template to every compaction. Never compacts by itself.

threshold.title: Suggest at score
threshold.description: Score (0-100) from which the ready /compact is suggested

minTokens.title: Too small below (tokens)
minTokens.description: Context below this scores 0: nothing worth compacting yet

fullTokens.title: Full at (tokens)
fullTokens.description: Context at which the fill part of the score is complete

cacheTtlMin.title: Cache TTL (min)
cacheTtlMin.description: Minutes after a turn the prompt cache counts as warm (5, or 60 with the 1-hour cache)

systemOneUrl.title: System One URL
systemOneUrl.description: Kev's System One base URL for P1 (loopback only; empty turns P1 off)

kevModel.title: Kev model
kevModel.description: System One model asked for P1

guardCompactions.title: Template on every compaction
guardCompactions.description: Add the preservation template to every /compact and auto-compaction of the main conversation

ignoreLeftovers.title: Ignore leftovers
ignoreLeftovers.description: Leftovers neither gate nor cap the score nor count in it; for a coordinator session that always waits on others

language.title: Language
language.description: Words of the status line and explanation: ru or en

alertPercent.title: Alert at context share (%)
alertPercent.description: From this share of the window the status line alerts, a toast shows once and /compact is suggested at turn end, whatever the score; 0 turns it off

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the score on the status line
